question: Can mod-p-squared Jacobian q-multiplication replace Qp probe evaluation in the affine two-plus-two selector on fresh public hits while preserving every selected residue and exact rational depth?
generator_law: first finite point by ascending x then y whose cofactor multiple has exact prime order q
query_law: first 16 lexicographic ordered distinct offsets with both U=Q-t1G and V=Q-t2G nonidentity
candidate_law: same centered two-image interpolation and equal-x exceptional model as the pinned source protocol
leading_residue: for each qP_i, t_i=-x/y in the p-adic formal kernel; c_i=(t_i/p) mod p in F_p, computed before coefficient outcomes on rational lifts
family_score: number of the 13 predeclared vectors (a,b) with a*c1+b*c2=0 mod p
selection_rule: use those five modular residues in the frozen affine two-plus-two lookup; score only matching rational models; full-grid fallback if no valid match
baseline_rule: minimum full model score then lexicographic shift
oracle_rule: for diagnostics only, select minimum-model candidate among those with cancellation for the already-known public relation vector
prediction_gate: for every public relation hit and candidate, test whether a*c1+b*c2=0 mod p if and only if the exact rational residual has formal-parameter depth at least 2, including exact identity as success
controls: verify finite public relation, rational model and point reduction, P1+(-P1)=O, qP_i kernel depth, and independently replay every leading residue and rational residual
claim_boundary: fresh finite panel and frozen model family; modular-Jacobian formula is conditional on valid smooth reduction, integral model coefficients, qP in kernel and Y a unit; full general Lean bridge remains open; no same-target IC/rho comparison
family_comparator: maximize fixed-family score, then minimum full model score and lexicographic shift
cost_boundary: record modular q-multiplication probe time separately from Qp probe validation, lookup, model construction, selected Qp confirmation, and exact rational check; no cross-panel speedup claim
paired_comparator: apply the identical cancellation and tie rule to the nested 625-model narrow grid on the same public hit; if none, narrow-grid minimum-model baseline
affine_rule: for each coordinate lead c_i, c_i(s)=c_i(0)+sum_j s_j*(c_i(e_j)-c_i(0)) mod p; evaluate only the five probe models over Qp before selection
validation_rule: after selection, run checked Sage Qp(p,prec=8) on every probe and selected model, compare both leading residues and exact selected rational depth; independent audit enumerates full grid and reconstructs modular residues and exact rational residuals
search_rule: after five Qp probes, let d0=a*c1(0)+b*c2(0), dj=a*(c1(ej)-c1(0))+b*(c2(ej)-c2(0)) mod p; hash all 49 values d0+s1*d1+s2*d2; for each 49 right pair (s3,s4), query key -(s3*d3+s4*d4) mod p; construct and score matching lifts only
exception_rule: for equal-x opposite branch use its single specified model and one Qp probe; retain candidate errors and fallback status
probe_rule: construct five rational probe models; reduce A and each point modulo p^2; compute [q]P in Jacobian coordinates modulo p^2; with Z divisible by p and Y a unit, set t=-X*Z/Y modulo p^2 and c=(t/p) mod p
